summary: All three gates green, invariant independently confirmed complete at every snapshot consumer, reconcile test inverts, four mutants all caught, no defects.
gates: lint=0 type-check=0 test=0 web=29/190 (api=24/248 unchanged, shared-utils=1/17 unchanged; +1 file +9 tests, nothing removed)
acceptance_proven: yes - disabled+Salvando... affordance, dismissed-dialog mid-POST case, re-enable after resolve, and the follow-up PATCH carrying the persisted uuid are all asserted; the reconcile-removal inversion is reproduced
invariant_complete: yes - my own enumeration: filtered at L546 dashboard, L1007 area filter options, L1052 DashboardView, L1056 SalesView, L1088 CommissionsView, L1091/1092 ProductsView, L1123/1124 ProductDialog, L1158 SaleWizardDialog. Raw only at L548-558 sales/saleItems for filteredSales, L589/804/847/1034 payables, L1068+L1079 PeopleView, L1098 ClientsView, L1104 AreasView, L1110/1113 settings. Exactly the four by-design cadastro reads plus sales/saleItems/payables/settings; no other raw read exists. useSalesOpsBootstrap is called only at L514 so there is no bypass. Transitivity checked: ProductDialog gets only areas+collaborators (both filtered) and its activeAreas/currentArea derive from that prop; SaleWizardDialog passes only props.bootstrap to the body, whose sellers/finders/collaborators memos, activeAreas, areaNameById, cliente datalist+name-to-id lookup, prestador datalist and prestador select all derive from that one prop.
request_body_leak_possible: no - could not construct one. All six request-body pickers read the filtered snapshot; products/sales/saleItems/payables/receivables/settings are never optimistically written; the wizard can never observe an optimistic row so it cannot hold one in state. Proven mutationally: reverting ProductDialog areas alone to raw bootstrap.areas turns the picker test red.
reconcile_test_inverts: yes - no-oping useOptimisticBootstrapWrite.onSuccess (hooks.ts:98-112) turned exactly 'edits the persisted uuid, not the optimistic id, once the create POST resolves' red ('button not found: Editar FXL BPO Sales') while the other 8 tests and the pre-existing optimistic.test.ts 8 tests stayed green, confirming the earlier gap. The refetch cannot mask it: bootstrap deferred index 1 is asserted issued (toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)) and deliberately never resolved, and the assertion is on the actual saveArea PATCH payload rather than rendered text.
vacuous_tests: none - four mutants all caught. (1) removing disabled={pending} from AreasView with the test's own .disabled assertion stubbed to a tautology fails at line 336 expect(querySelector('form')).toBeNull() with the AreaDialog form in the failure dump, so the post-click negative genuinely catches a reopened dialog. (2) the ninth test is a working positive control: it finds Editar <name>, asserts disabled===false and title==='Editar', asserts Salvando <name> absent, clicks and asserts the prefilled form appears. (3) removing the withoutOptimisticRows early return reddens the reference-identity test. (4) reverting the ProductDialog seam reddens the picker test. No absent-assertion lacks a paired presence assertion: each 'Editar X is null' follows a successful lookup of 'Salvando X' on the same element, the two being branches of one ternary.
memo_reference_stable: yes - instrumented SalesOpsApp to record bootstrap and persistedBootstrap identities per render, then drove 3 extra re-renders via the Filtros toggle on /operacional/vendas. Nothing optimistic: 5 renders, 2 distinct raw identities, 2 distinct filtered identities, element-wise toBe equality between the sets (persistedBootstrap IS bootstrap). With an optimistic area cached: 5 renders, 2 raw, 2 filtered. Zero per-render allocation either way. Holds because useMemo deps are [bootstrap] and selectSalesOpsBootstrap is hoisted (hooks.ts:40) keeping TanStack's select memo alive; the wizard-remount class is separately fenced by key={editSale?.id ?? 'create'} at L3696.
disabled_state_not_stuck: yes - probed the reject path: create area, dismiss dialog mid-POST, reject. Result: row text gone, no 'Salvando X' button, no 'Editar X' button, bootstrap refetched (2 calls). onError rolls the row out entirely and useAppMutation invalidates in onSettled on success AND failure (documented in apps/web/src/lib/app-mutation.ts), so the cache always re-syncs. Both terminal states exit the disabled state. Noted as pre-existing, not defects of this slice: the rollback is silent once the dialog is dismissed (row vanishes with no toast, slice-01 behaviour, worth a follow-up doubt), and two concurrent creates where the second fails momentarily resurrect the first optimistic id before onSettled's refetch replaces it - during which the row is disabled rather than dangerous, strictly better than before.
tests_weakened: none - git diff --numstat master..branch -- '*test*' is '521 0', one new file, additions only. No pre-existing test file touched. No .only/.skip/xit/xdescribe/todo in any added line.
scope_ok: yes - exactly 3 files, all under apps/web/src/sales-ops/. apps/web/src/admin was left alone and the twin defect is confirmed still present there (useProducts.ts optimisticProductRowFromBody mints id: optimistic:${appId}:${slug}, and ProductsPage.tsx feeds product.id into setEditProduct and navigate('/admin/products/'+id) unguarded) - correctly deferred per CLAUDE.md's /admin/* fence and the plan's scope limits. Empty diff against apps/api, packages, navigation.ts, and the seller/finder legacy trees. No propostas status machine, payables/receivables, or auth/tenancy change.
forward_coupling_judged: acceptable - navigation.ts:59 is label 'Produtos' and the nav renders aria-label={item.label} at SalesOpsApp.tsx:807, so the slice-10 rename breaks the picker test at exactly one line with an explicit 'nav Produtos not found' throw. Loud, single-point, one-line fix the renaming slice must make anyway. Style-only nit: a data-testid or route-based navigation would have decoupled it.
